motion_rule: he runs downhill the whole clip, gravity dragging him, while rock walls, bushes and goats tear past and come at the lens every beat; the camera runs alongside him, his face to the lens, his head half the frame and never smaller than his shoulders filling the width; new shot size each beat, one action per beat, the hero driving it; the tall frame filled edge to edge, no bars, no wide landscape
character: a shaggy musk ox, heavy fringed coat, broad horns, a cardboard box riding on his crown and horns, his muzzle and jaw out below its rim and always clear
second_characters: A SWARM of mountain goats bounding across the trail a shoulder from the lens, cutting the frame crosswise every beat, one landing on the rocks right beside his head
props: ONE cardboard box on his head with a torn hole at his left eye, on him from the first beat to the last
environment: a high mountain trail at noon, rock walls and scree a hoof away both sides, bushes and boulders packed tight along the path, peaks crowding just past his shoulders, no empty distance
light_events: sun flares between the rocks across his face every beat

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 3.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka, o-be-SHCHA-la, zo-lo-TY-ye, GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDYE-to, ug-LOM
audio.pacing: 0.40-4.20 and 5.05-8.45 each one breath; after 8.45 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and his lips shape every syllable below the box rim, brows and jaw alive, the box never over his muzzle, never a voice over
audio.sfx: wind over the ridge, hooves hammering scree, cardboard flapping, goats clattering on rock

timeline.a: he pitches over the crest and drops into the run, the box already on his horns
he hammers downhill straight at the lens, scree spraying off his hooves past it
he shoulders through a bush that bursts across the lens and never breaks stride
he swings his horned head and the box with it, raking the rock wall a hoof away
he throws his chest at the lens as a goat lands on the rocks beside his head
his eye fills the torn hole and blinks once at the lens while the rock wall tears past behind the box and a goat cuts across the hole
he takes the trail in one long bound over a boulder, hooves slamming down at the lens, goats scattering off both walls
he hauls his shoulder along the rock wall and knocks a slab of scree into the lens
he drives his chest at the lens, the box askew, a goat vaulting his back
he cuts hard into the bend, the whole wall wiping past behind him
he swings his head round the corner to the lens and there is nothing but more peaks
he shakes his head and the box slews on his horns, the hole swinging off his eye
he punches his shoulders back into the run and drives past the lens, face to it

must_appear: the box on his head with a torn hole from first beat to last; at 4.20 his eye in the hole blinking at the lens; goats bounding across the trail beside his head; at 7.70 he turns his head round the bend and finds more peaks
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a wide landscape shot, empty sky filling the frame, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a held pose, a closed muzzle while speaking, the box over his mouth, an emblem or logo in his eye, slow motion, a camera pulling back, running uphill, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
